_source: Added 2026-08 at explicit user request for a subtle, Profile-only travel recommendation feature — not transcribed from the Claude Design handoff bundle (Curia.dc.html has no destination/travel concept at all). All 20 are real, well-known European destinations, hand-picked to skew toward Curia's own high-end-curated positioning rather than mass-market package-holiday spots. `tileIds` reference the real onboarding Tile catalog (docs/data/tiles.json, id format `${category}|${name}`) so a destination's match is scored against the exact same taste vocabulary a member's own preferences are stored in — not a parallel vocabulary invented for this feature. Curator initials (Elena M., James O., Priya N.) reuse the same three curators CLAUDE.md confirms from the prototype's own Moments data, so this reads as the same editorial team rather than a new persona. `bestMonths`/`bestSeasonLabel` are original judgment calls (real seasonal character of each place — nightlife islands in high summer, ski towns in winter, wine regions at harvest), not scored inputs into the matching logic, matching how District.editorialDescription is prose alongside (not a substitute for) its structured dayMultiplier/bandMultiplier.

destinations.name: Mallorca
destinations.editorialDescription: Palma by night and Port d'Andratx by lunch — the island plays both registers well, and rarely makes you choose between them in the same week.

destinations.name: Ibiza
destinations.editorialDescription: Still the room the rest of the world's clubs are quietly trying to be a version of. Book the villa away from town; you'll want the recovery time.

destinations.name: Mykonos
destinations.editorialDescription: A loud kind of beautiful that's clearly rehearsed. Lunch at a beach club here is a performance worth the ticket price.

destinations.name: Costa Smeralda
destinations.editorialDescription: Money that arrived by boat and intends to stay that way. The marina table at Porto Cervo does more work than any itinerary.

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.editorialDescription: Every terrace has the same caldera view and somehow none of them feel repeated. Go before or after the cruise-ship months.

destinations.name: Dubrovnik
destinations.editorialDescription: The Old Town earns the reputation even against your better judgment about crowds. Walk the walls at 7am, before the day-trippers wake.

destinations.name: Florence
destinations.editorialDescription: A city that assumes you already know what the Duomo means, and is generally right to. Book the Uffizi slot before you book the restaurant.

destinations.name: Prague
destinations.editorialDescription: Better in low light and cold air than any brochure photo suggests. The jazz cellars near the Old Town are worth staying up for.

destinations.name: Vienna
destinations.editorialDescription: Opera on a Tuesday isn't an occasion here. It's Tuesday. Dress like it's still an occasion anyway.

destinations.name: Bruges
destinations.editorialDescription: Small enough to walk twice in one afternoon and still find a canal you missed the first time.

destinations.name: Porto
destinations.editorialDescription: Ribeira at golden hour, with a glass from across the river, does more work than any menu description could.

destinations.name: Piedmont
destinations.editorialDescription: The white truffle fair alone justifies the trip. The Barolo, poured by the people who made it, is the reason you'll come back.

destinations.name: Douro Valley
destinations.editorialDescription: Portugal's answer to Tuscany, terraced vineyards and all, without the queue for the view.

destinations.name: Copenhagen
destinations.editorialDescription: A city that plates food like it's daring you to disagree, and a design scene that means the plate itself is also the argument.

destinations.name: Chamonix
destinations.editorialDescription: Two entirely different holidays depending on the month you book — Mont Blanc doesn't mind which one you pick.

destinations.name: Zermatt
destinations.editorialDescription: No cars, no traffic noise, one mountain doing all the talking. The hotel bars know exactly how to let it.

destinations.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
destinations.editorialDescription: Freshly proven as an Olympic stage this February — the lifts and the views were never really the ones in question.

destinations.name: Sotogrande
destinations.editorialDescription: Valderrama is the headline, but the real draw is a place built around never having to explain yourself. Polo season is worth timing for.

destinations.name: The Algarve
destinations.editorialDescription: Quinta do Lago in the morning, a beach club by two — the Algarve is one of the few places that doesn't make you choose.

destinations.name: Sicily
destinations.editorialDescription: Etna smoking gently in the background of every dinner, which somehow never stops being worth the glance.
